example.title: George Cather Farmstead, house, 552 Road T

brief: Rambling two-storey white clapboard farmhouse with a cross-gabled roof in rust-brown asphalt shingle and three tall cream-painted chimneys; each front gable carries a small oval window set in a panel of decorative shingles. A hip-roofed wraparound porch on round white columns runs along the front and side, and its roof forms an upper deck with a white spindle balustrade reached from a pair of glazed doors. Big blue spruces and cedars crowd the front, bare cottonwoods behind; a steel windmill, round grain bins and a small white shed stand off across a ploughed field and a gravel road.
